R696.note: jwt.verify with pinned algorithms and try/catch closes the forged-token path; the new JWT_SECRET startup requirement is unavoidable and stated, and valid admin tokens still pass.

R697.note: Untrusted input is removed from the env array, but the fix also promotes param to a command argument the original never passed and adds an allowlist whose IllegalArgumentException escapes doPost as a 500 for values with spaces or other legitimate characters (stated, so not silent).

R698.note: Swapping libxmljs for fast-xml-parser with processEntities:false removes entity resolution entirely and the XPath-to-property migration is stated; minor unstated nuance is that processEntities:false also leaves predefined entities such as & undecoded in the returned id.

R699.note: Re-indexing tasks[activeIndex] after push_back removes the dangling reference with identical semantics and no other change.

R700.note: SigningMethodHMAC assertion in keyFunc plus WithValidMethods pins the algorithm; the HS256 pin is the fix itself, and HMAC-signed tokens still authenticate.

R701.note: Strict in_array allowlist runs before require so traversal and stream wrappers fail closed; the contract explicitly calls for rejecting names before require and summary stays the default, though the extra names details/preview are guessed.

R702.note: Deletion moves to POST behind CrossOriginProtection with the GET route kept as a same-origin confirmation form; the extra confirmation step is inherent to the fix and stated plainly.

R703.note: Path.resolve plus is_relative_to follows the symlink before the containment check, nested reports still open, missing paths still raise FileNotFoundError, and the controller's download_name is untouched (the write-up's TOCTTOU claim for strict=True is overstated but harmless).

R704.note: Leaving sh -c in place and appending param as a separate list element makes it $0, not an echo argument: confirmed by running 'sh -c echo marker' in a scratch dir, which prints only a newline, so injection is closed only incidentally and the endpoint silently stops echoing the parameter while the write-up claims the opposite.

R705.note: Per-stream setObjectInputFilter keeps the native wire format and blocks gadget classes; the pattern 'evalcases.OrderEvent;java.base/*;!*' was run on JDK 26 in a scratch dir and both allows the target class and rejects an out-of-module class, and the RuntimeException path is preserved.

R706.note: AES/GCM/NoPadding with a fresh SecureRandom 12-byte IV replaces the ECB default; the IV-prefix format change is inherent to leaving ECB and is stated explicitly, and the base64 body and 400-on-missing-ssn are preserved.

R707.note: The bytesRead < 8 guard fails closed on the short-header bypass and rejects nothing a real PNG or PDF would send; ReadExactly would be the more robust API but the check is correct as written.

R708.note: Escaping ( ) * and backslash does close the filter injection, but the escape table maps the space character to a NUL escape, silently rewriting any legitimate value containing a space into one carrying a NUL so the search never matches, and the write-up misdescribes that branch as escaping the NUL character.
